events.verdict: Reaves (LAL) and Clowney (BKN) come together and marginal contact occurs after the loose ball is deflected away by Hayes (LAL).
Johnson (BKN) moves alongside Reaves' (LAL) path and he avoids making contact to Reaves' arm after his gather.
Johnson (BKN) moves slightly toward Reaves' (LAL) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive. This contact does not affect Reaves' SQBR during the drive.
Christie (LAL) legally contests Russell's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Claxton (BKN) grasps James' (LAL) jersey and immediately releases it as marginal contact occurs during the pursuit of the rebound.
Vincent (LAL) and Clowney (BKN) come together while in pursuit of the loose ball and the marginal contact occurs.
